paragraphs.text: Jareth , Leonine Titan , is a humanoid Cat Giant who was active in the Pre-Mending era of Dominara as a pit-fighter .

Jareth is a megalith, or giant lion-like living sandstone statue at least 10 — and likely over 20 feet tall. His only weapon is a shield, as he is a defense-oriented fighter. At some point, he became a fighter in the Great Coliseum of Otaria .
